name: Detective’s Cap
body:
Price 9,500 gp; Slot head; CL 7th; Weight 1/2 lb.; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This tweed hunter’s cap is favored those who seek to the truth no matter how hidden it may be. The wearer of the detective’s cap gains a +4 competence bonus to Perception and Sense Motive. In addition, the wearer can make a Knowledge (local) check with a +10 competence bonus to attempt to follow tracks in cities, villages, or other settlements. This Knowledge (local) check to follow tracks can be made untrained.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,750 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, fox’s cunning, owl’s wisdom
